name: Bento Grid
description: Modular blocks of varying sizes laid out as an irregular grid. Each block is a feature, a quote, an image, a stat. Visual rhythm comes from size variation, not card uniformity.

name: Long Document
description: Reads like a memo, a letter, or a journal entry. No marketing structure. Continuous prose with inline section heads. The page is *literature* about the product.

name: Marquee Hero
description: The hero IS the page above the fold. A single bold statement or visual fills the viewport. No subhead, no CTA in fold. Below the fold the page becomes something else (a list, a grid, prose).

name: Stat-Led
description: The hero is a giant number — a metric, a count, a percentage. Everything that follows supports or qualifies it. Data is the narrative.

name: Workbench
description: Product screenshots in frames are the primary content. The page is a guided tour of the app in use. Less marketing copy, more "here's what you do with it."

name: Conversational FAQ
description: Bold questions, brief answers. The page reads like an honest interview with the product. Often each Q/A is a collapsible accordion.

name: Manifesto
description: Polemical large type. Declaration energy. The page tells the reader what to believe before it tells them what to buy. Often political-poster aesthetic.

name: Photographic
description: A single huge image dominates each fold. Text is small annotation, not headline. The design says *look* before it says *read*.

name: Quote-Led
description: The hero is a pull-quote with attribution. The headline is borrowed credibility, not the brand's voice. The page leads with social proof.

name: Specimen
description: Numbered left-margin labels, huge serif display, asymmetric column spans, hairline rules, typographic-only CTA, generous whitespace. Editorial / type-foundry energy.

name: Catalogue
description: Uniform grid of variations of the same thing — typefaces, colour palettes, product SKUs. The page is a visual index of inventory.

name: Letter
description: First-person, written, intimate. Opens with a greeting ("Dear friend,"). No buttons in the fold. Reads as a personal note from the founder.

name: Index-First
description: The page IS a list of links. No hero image, no narrative flow. Pure navigation as design.

name: Narrative Workflow
description: Numbered stages tell the story of how the user uses the product over time. Each section is a phase (1.0 → 2.0 → 3.0 → 4.0). The page is a process timeline.

name: Split Studio
description: Diptych. Every major content block divides the screen — text on one side, proof on the other. The pairing alternates direction down the page.

name: Feature Stack
description: Sticky left pane (label / description) + scroll-synced right pane (screenshots cycling through related details). Cinematic pacing.

name: Type Specimen
description: The typeface IS the design. Foundry homepage or design-system marketing where a custom typeface is the brand's proof.

name: Portfolio Grid
description: Filterable cards of projects. Studio or designer homepages where the work is the product.

name: Map / Diagram
description: A single large spatial diagram organises the page — flowchart, floor plan, network graph, system map. Information is laid out *spatially*, not linearly.

name: Ecosystem Index
description: Multiple discovery surfaces — featured / latest / by category / by people. The platform's value is emergence and browsing, not declaration.

name: Component Playground
description: Interactive code-and-preview blocks are the page's primary content. Each block previews a thing and shows how to copy-paste it.
